author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬದುಕಿಗಿರೆ ಗುರಿಯೊಂದು ಜೀವನದ ಗುರಿಯೊಂದು
ಎದುರಿಸುತ ನಡೆಯುವುದೆ ನಿನ್ನ ಸಾಧನೆಯು
ಬದಿಸರಿಸಿ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ನೋವುಗಳ ನಡೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಪದತಲದಿ ಗೆಲುವಿಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Life has one goal; living has one aim:
to walk on, facing whatever comes, is your achievement;
push hardships aside, and walking on through the pain,
you will find victory at your feet, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Having a goal and facing life squarely is itself the achievement. Keep walking past difficulties and pain, and success will come.
